claims: Aerial application 0-1000 flying hours: $978.10 a week ($51,001 a year) from 1 July 2026.
whys: $978.10 a week is below the $1,004.90 a week modern award minimum from 1 July 2026. Award rates are normally lifted to at least that floor in the Annual Wage Review, so this looks like a pre-AWR figure or a misread. The 1001-2000 rate equals $1,004.90 exactly, which suggests the floor was applied there.
reviewerNotes: I agree with the writer's factQuestions. Aerial application 0-1000 hours is $978.10 a week. First Officer single engine at $52,257 works out to about $1,002 a week. Both are below the $1,004.90 a week minimum. The 'lowest minimum salary' trainee claim conflicts with the $51,001 aerial rate. The instrument status date of 1 Jan 2010 may describe the 2010 predecessor award. All 4 are passed through. No source text was changed.

claims: A Limited Roster Store Assistant gets $36.30 on weekday evenings and on Saturdays to 8pm. Early mornings (6am to 7am) and Sundays from 9am to 8pm pay $42.95. Late Saturdays, overnight hours and Sunday evenings pay $43.41, Sundays before 9am or after 11pm $56.26, and public holidays $62.92.
Limited Roster bands: 6am to 7am is grouped with Sunday 9am to 8pm at $42.95. Late Saturdays, overnight hours and Sunday evenings are $43.41.
whys: The Limited Roster bands do not line up with the Full-time/Flexible table (lines 93-100). In the Full-time table, 6am to 7am sits with overnight hours at $43.78, and Sunday 9am to 11pm is a single band at $43.78. The Limited Roster note puts 6am to 7am with Sundays at $42.95 ($42.95 / $29.64 = 1.449, the same ratio as $43.78 / $30.21), and splits Sunday at 8pm. Its $43.41 band ($43.41 / $29.64 = 1.465) matches no Full-time ratio: Full-time Saturday 8pm to 11pm is 1.437 and overnight is 1.449. Either the band grouping or the $43.41 figure looks mis-transcribed. Please re-check Sch 2 Part D in AE531722.
